data.title: Fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for speeding – €98.50
data.summary: The Landkreis Musterheide Bußgeldstelle issued Hendrik Musterbrügge a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for driving 19 km/h over the 50 km/h limit in Musterhausen in der Heide on 9 September 2026. The total amount of €98.50 becomes payable once the notice is legally final, unless an objection (Einspruch) is filed within the deadline shown.
data.explanation: This is an official notice of a traffic fine (Bußgeldbescheid) for a speeding violation. You may decide whether to accept it or to file an objection (Einspruch) with the Bußgeldstelle, in writing or in person; the app shows the deadline for this. If you do not object in time, the notice becomes legally final and the €98.50 (fine, administrative fee and delivery costs) must be paid two weeks after it becomes final. If you believe the measurement or circumstances were wrong, consider getting legal advice (e.g. a traffic lawyer) before the deadline shown.

remedy.period_text: Die Einspruchsfrist beträgt zwei Wochen; sie beginnt mit der Zustellung dieses Bescheids.
remedy.quote: Gegen diesen Bußgeldbescheid können Sie Einspruch einlegen, und zwar beim Landkreis Musterheide – Bußgeldstelle schriftlich oder dort zur Niederschrift.
